_meta.note: 一个任务一个文件。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.src: Y'see, I got a few things here... look around for a bit, they're all very rare...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.dst: 你瞧，我这里有几样东西……随便看看，全都很稀有……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#002.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.src: I see that look in yer eyes... Ya interested in something here? It's all 'fa sale...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.dst: 我看得出你眼里那股劲……对哪样东西有兴趣？全都卖……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#003.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.src: ..Say, humie... I ain't mean to alarm ya, but do ya know who that guy sneakin' up behind 'ye is?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.dst: ……喂，人类小家伙……我不是想吓你，不过你知道偷偷摸到你背后的那家伙是谁吗？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#004.speaker: Merchant

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#005.src: OI! Wake up, you damned miscreant!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#005.dst: 喂！醒醒，你这该死的恶棍！

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.src: Took ya long enough.. Alright, listen up, maggot!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.dst: 终于醒了……好，给我听着，蛆虫！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#006.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.src: We found ya outside of {p}, passed out near some dead body, and... Well, we had to arrest someone for that merchant's death!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.dst: 我们在 {p} 外面发现你倒在一具尸体旁边，而且……嗯，那个商人的死总得抓个人来顶罪！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#007.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.src: And don't think you get to just lounge around all day in your cell. You gotta do work here, or you're getting thrown in the hole.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.dst: 别以为你可以整天在牢房里闲着。你在这里得干活，不然就把你扔进禁闭洞。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#009.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.src: But for now, you’re stayin’ in your cell, understood? Now, stay here, and take a look around your cell. You'll know when it's time to work..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.dst: 不过现在，你给我待在牢房里，懂吗？待着，四处看看你的牢房。该干活的时候你自然会知道……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#010.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.src: GWAH! Who the hell are you?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#012.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.src: Oh, thank grook, you're just another prisoner... So young, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.dst: 噢，谢天谢地，你只是另一个囚犯……还这么年轻……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#013.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.src: You just got here, right? Well... I can tell you're innocent... Just like almost everyone else in this forsaken prison...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.dst: 你刚来，对吧？嗯……我看得出你是无辜的……就跟这座被遗弃的监狱里几乎所有人一样……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#014.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.src: Listen, human... This prison... You couldn't have come to a more horrific prison in the entire world! This place is hellish!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.dst: 听着，人类……这座监狱……全世界没有比这更可怕的监狱了！这地方就是地狱！！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#015.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.src: The guards here, they're sadistic! They'll pluck random prisoners out of their cells, and nobody ever sees them again! They're trying to kill us all in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.dst: 这里的守卫都是虐待狂！他们会随便把囚犯从牢房里拖走，然后再也没人见过他们！他们想把我们全杀了！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#016.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.src: I'm being serious, human! If you stay here, they'll kill you, too! You HAVE to escape this place, whatever it t-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.dst: 我是认真的，人类！你要是待在这里，他们也会杀了你！不管付出什么代价，你都得逃出去——
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#017.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.src: Oi, filth! You're comin' with us. Get out of your cell, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.dst: 喂，垃圾！你跟我们走。马上出你的牢房！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#018.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.src: Are you sure, uh, sir? I don't think I'm supposed to be anywhere today...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.dst: 你确定吗，呃，长官？我今天应该没有要去哪里……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#019.speaker: Old Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.src: Oh, ya think you're smart, trying to resist?? Oi, Jon, block the entrance!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.dst: 噢，你以为反抗很聪明是吧？？喂，Jon，把入口堵住！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#020.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.src: H-HEY! WHAT ARE YOU- GET OFF- AAAAAHH!! SOMEONE!! HELP ME!!! PLEASE!!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.dst: 嘿、嘿！你们要干什么——放开——啊啊啊啊！！来人啊！！救命！！！求求你们！！！！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#021.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.src: OI! Quit starin’ off into space, maggot! Come over to your cell's bars.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.dst: 喂！别再发呆了，蛆虫！过来牢房的铁栏这边。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#022.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.src: It’s work time, filth. I'll escort you to the hallways. Once you're there, someone will tell you what to do. Do as they say, and you might come back tonight.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.dst: 干活时间到了，垃圾。我押你去走廊。到了那里，会有人告诉你该做什么。照他们说的做，你今晚也许还回得来。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#023.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.src: You got that, wretch? Alright, now get out of your cell!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.dst: 听懂了吗，废物？好，现在出你的牢房！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#024.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#025.src: Get your instructions from the guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.src: Guess you're the one on cleanin' duty, huh? Alright. Listen up, scum!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.dst: 看来你就是负责打扫的，是吧？好。给我听着，人渣！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#026.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.src: Take this sponge, and look around the hallways. If you see a mess, use the sponge to clean it up. Someone will escort you back to the cells once you're done.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.dst: 拿着这块海绵，在走廊里四处看看。看到脏乱的地方就用海绵清干净。等你弄完会有人押你回牢房。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#027.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.src: Got it? Alright. Now, get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#028.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#029.src: Search the hallways for messes to clean up
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#029.dst: 在走廊里寻找需要清理的脏乱处

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#030.src: Report to the prison guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.src: You're done cleaning? Alright, it's time for rollcall. You're being escorted back to the cell block. Follow me, and don't move.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.dst: 打扫完了？好，点名时间到了。我押你回牢房区。跟着我，别乱动。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#031.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.src: Well, well, well... Looks like the dross of society is here on time!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.dst: 哟哟哟……看来社会的渣滓都准时到了嘛！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#032.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.src: Alright. Stay in line, and don't move, maggots! It's time for roll call...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.dst: 好。排好队，别动，蛆虫们！点名开始……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#033.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.src: You’re all here… Ha! That’s a surprise, you outcasts can actually follow orders!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.dst: 你们全都在……哈！真意外，你们这些弃民居然也听得懂命令！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#035.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.src: ...Hm… Looks like we’ve got a new arrival too.. Don’t worry, peon... your soul will be well secure here for the rest of eternity.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.dst: ……嗯……看来还来了个新人……别担心，贱民……你的灵魂会在这里被好好保管，直到永远。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#036.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.src: Alright. That’s it for now, you worthless menaces. It’s meal time. Head to the cafeteria, and pray that we’re not giving you your last meal.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.dst: 好。暂时就这样，你们这些没用的祸害。吃饭时间到了。去食堂，祈祷我们给你们的不是最后一餐吧。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#037.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#038.src: Find a place to sit in the cafeteria
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#038.dst: 在食堂里找个位子坐下

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.src: Hi... Say, could you... do something for me...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.dst: 嗨……喂，你能不能……帮我个忙……？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#039.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.src: I'm... starving to death here... those blasted guards won't... let me get any food...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.dst: 我……快饿死了……那些该死的守卫……不让我拿任何吃的……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#040.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.src: Please... to my right... There's some food sitting there, if you could get it for me, I'd be... eternally grateful...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.dst: 拜托……我右边……那里放着一些食物，如果你能帮我拿过来，我会……永远感激你……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#041.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.src: I... I can't thank you enough, human... I should be able to keep going with this...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.dst: 我……真不知道该怎么谢你，人类……有了这个我应该能撑下去……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#043.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.src: Say... if you ever get out of this slaughterhouse... could you go to {p}... and try and talk with my family, there? Let them know that I'm still alive...? I'd appreciate that....
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.dst: 喂……如果你能逃出这座屠宰场……能不能去 {p}……找我的家人谈谈？让他们知道我还活着……？我会很感激的……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#044.speaker: Starving Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.src: Hey.. It's alright, you can sit here, don't worry.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.dst: 嘿……没关系，你可以坐这里，别担心。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#045.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.src: So... you're new here, right? Hah… Guessing you're innocent, just like the rest of us… and I mean that...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.dst: 那么……你是新来的，对吧？哈……我猜你是无辜的，就跟我们其他人一样……我是说真的……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#046.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.src: He's tellin' the truth, new guy. Most of us here are just average civilians. I worked at a transportation company in {p}, and was delivering some crates to {p} when they snatched me just out of town.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.dst: 他说的是真的，新来的。我们这里大部分人只是普通老百姓。我在 {p} 的一家运输公司工作，正要把几箱货送到 {p}，刚出城就被他们抓了。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#047.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.src: Me too! I don't even know why I was put here at all! I wasn't even given a trial in court, or anything! They just plucked me off the streets and threw me in here!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.dst: 我也是！我连自己为什么被关进来都不知道！连审判都没有，什么都没有！他们就直接把我从街上拖走，丢进这里！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#048.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.src: They wanna kill you, that's why. Did ya hear about Revan? He got taken away a couple of days ago, after he accidentally stumbled during roll call. Nobody's heard or seen 'em since.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.dst: 他们想杀了你，就是这么回事。你听说 Revan 的事了吗？他几天前点名时不小心绊了一下，就被带走了。从那以后没人再听过、见过他。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#049.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.src: I… you're probably right... I just dont understand any of this anymore... I just want to escape this damn place for good...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.dst: 我……你大概说得对……我已经什么都搞不懂了……我只想永远逃出这个该死的地方……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#050.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.src: ...Good luck with that.. Only way out is through that exit door, and even then you gotta get into the Control Room, as well. It's...just impossible, y'know?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.dst: ……祝你好运吧……唯一的出路是那扇出口门，就算这样你还得进得了控制室。这……根本不可能，懂吗？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#051.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.src: Alright, meal time's over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.dst: 好，吃饭时间结束！回你们的牢房去，垃圾！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#052.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.src: ...Well… That's this place in a nutshell for you, human. Just try not to get in anyone's way or step out of line, and you should be alright until they end up taking you.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.dst: ……嗯……这地方大概就是这样，人类。尽量别挡任何人的路，也别出格，在他们把你带走之前你应该都还好。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#053.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.src: Oi, who’s this guy right ‘ere? We don’t know ya. Move it!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.dst: 喂，这家伙是谁？我们不认识你。滚开！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#054.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.src: ‘Ey, ‘ey, let it rest, Don. They're not hurtin’ nobody.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.dst: 嘿，嘿，算了吧，Don。他们又没伤害谁。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#055.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.src: Don’t worry about it. So... You know who we are, novello?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.dst: 别在意。那么……你知道我们是谁吗，新来的？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#057.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.src: We’re part of the Placido Crime Family. We do business across the entire world; all parts of it, you know what I’m saying?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.dst: 我们是 Placido 犯罪家族的人。我们的生意遍布全世界；每个角落都有，懂我意思吧？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#058.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.src: Almost all of us at this table got caught for running with the family-... Ah, bet you’re surprised to hear that there are some guilty people up in this slaughterhouse, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.dst: 我们这桌几乎所有人都是因为替家族办事被抓的——……啊，我敢打赌你很意外，这座屠宰场里居然也有真的有罪的人，是吧？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#059.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.src: It’s alright, you don’t have to worry about us getting plucked and killed like those other piacevole here. Guards keep on sayin’ something about “our souls are too tainted”, whatever they mean.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.dst: 没关系，你不用担心我们会像这里其他那些老好人一样被拖走杀掉。守卫老是说什么“我们的灵魂太脏了”，天知道是什么意思。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#060.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.src: Hah! Maybe you’ll get the same treatment too, novello. I saw it the minute I laid eyes on ya. You’re a killer too, ain't ya? Hey, gotta be one to know you're dealin' with one..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.dst: 哈！说不定你也会受到同样的待遇，新来的。我第一眼看到你就看出来了。你也是个杀手，对吧？嘿，要是同类才认得出同类……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#061.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.src: ..Anyways... You thinkin’ about staying in this prison, fratello? Word of advice: Don’t. If you can, you gotta escape. You might think it’s impossible for someone to escape here, or whatnot...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.dst: ……总之……你在想要不要待在这座监狱吗，兄弟？给你个忠告：别待。能逃就得逃。你可能觉得在这里不可能逃得出去，或者之类的……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#062.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.src: Alright, meal time’s over! Get to your cells, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.dst: 好，吃饭时间结束！回你们的牢房去，垃圾！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#063.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.src: But no, you're different. I can see it in those eyes. You just gotta find a way into that Control Room, somehow. And hey, if you do get outta here, go and raise some hell in the Levtus Black Market for us, yeah?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.dst: 不过不，你不一样。我从那双眼睛里就看得出来。你只要想办法进到那个控制室就行。还有，嘿，如果你真的逃出去了，替我们去 Letvus 黑市闹一闹，好吗？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#064.speaker: Mafia Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.src: Alright, look straight, scum! Morning rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.dst: 好，站直了，人渣！早上点名马上开始。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#067.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.src: ...you’re all here...? Hm... Disappointing, honestly. Rollcall is over. All of you, head to wherever your job is, and get to work!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.dst: ……你们全都在……？嗯……说真的，挺让人失望的。点名结束。你们全都去自己的工作岗位，干活去！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#069.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.src: Search the hallways for possible escape routes, and find a guard outfit
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#070.dst: 在走廊里寻找可能的逃生路线，并找到一套守卫制服

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#071.src: Report to the Prison Guard at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.src: You're done? Alright, now follow me. Rollcall is about to start.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.dst: 弄完了？好，跟我来。点名马上开始。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#072.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.src: What with you all, showing up late like this?? It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.dst: 你们怎么回事，一个个都这么晚才到？？点名时间到了！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#073.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.src: You're all here, huh? Alright then, head on to dinn-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.dst: 你们全都在，是吧？好，那就去吃晚——
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#075.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.src: Oi! Quit steppin' on my shoes, cretino!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.dst: 喂！别再踩我的鞋了，白痴！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#076.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.src: Hey! What the hell are you talkin' about, making up something like that! I didn't do anythin'!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.dst: 嘿！你他妈在说什么，编出这种事！我什么都没做！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#077.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.src: Shut it, fat-nose! You know what you were doin'! Now stay out of my way!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.dst: 闭嘴，大鼻子！你自己知道你干了什么！现在给我滚远点！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#078.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.src: OI! Are you blind, or something?!? Get those lowlifes under control, guards!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.dst: 喂！你们瞎了还是怎样？！？把那些下三滥管好，守卫们！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#079.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.src: You two got some damn nerve, fightin' during rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.dst: 你们两个胆子可真大，敢在点名的时候打架！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#080.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.src: W-Woah, HEY! This maggot has a shank! Back up!!!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.dst: 哇、哇，喂！这只蛆虫有把自制刀！退后！！！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#081.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.src: LOCKDOWN! LOCKDOWN! ALL OF YOU, IN YOUR CELLS, NOW!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.dst: 封锁！封锁！你们所有人，马上回牢房！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#082.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.src: You two really are stupid, huh? Fighting in the midst of all of these guards? And you got a shank, too...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.dst: 你们两个还真是蠢，是吧？在这么多守卫面前打架？而且还带着自制刀……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#083.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.src: Well, looks like it's game over for you two outcasts. You're heading straight to the hole!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.dst: 嗯，看来你们两个弃民完蛋了。你们直接进禁闭洞！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#084.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.src: You, take these two cretins to the hole, and you, go to my office and get one of the spare control room keys. Now, LIGHTS OUT!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.dst: 你，把这两个白痴带去禁闭洞，还有你，去我的办公室拿一把备用的控制室钥匙。现在，熄灯！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#085.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.src: Alright, everyone get in line, and stand straight! Don't move, or it's game over for you!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.dst: 好，所有人排好队，站直！谁敢动，谁就完蛋！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#088.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.src: H-hey! Stop pushing me, mate! Seriou-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#090.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.src: Well, well, well... Another peon thought it was wise to step off course..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.dst: 哟哟哟……又有个贱民以为出列是聪明的做法……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#091.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.src: W-wait a minute, miss! Someone pushed me out of line! I swear!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.dst: 等、等一下，女士！有人把我推出队伍的！我发誓！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#092.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.src: BE QUIET! I didn't say you could speak, filth!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.dst: 闭嘴！我没说你可以讲话，垃圾！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#093.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.src: Get back in line! Once this is over, you're out, slime!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.dst: 回到队伍里！等这结束，你就完了，烂泥！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#094.speaker: The Warden

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.src: Steal the key from the warden's office, and head to the control room
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#096.dst: 从典狱长办公室偷走钥匙，前往控制室

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#097.src: Find a way to open the exit door

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#098.src: Head through the exit door at [-{~}, {~}, {~}]

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#099.src: Sneak past the guards and find a way to the Records Room
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#099.dst: 偷偷避开守卫，找到通往记录室的路

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.src: Oh, thank the bovine! There's a friendly face around here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.dst: 噢，感谢神牛！这里总算有张友善的脸了……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#101.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.src: Listen, human, you gotta get me out of here! They've been killin' people in here all day! If you don't help me out, I'll be next!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.dst: 听着，人类，你得把我弄出去！他们一整天都在这里杀人！你要是不帮我，下一个就是我！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#102.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.src: Look, next to my cell, on that desk! There's a key! Grab it and hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.dst: 看，我牢房旁边那张桌子上！有把钥匙！拿过来给我！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#103.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.src: Yes, perfect, PERFECT! That's the key, hand it to me!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.dst: 对，太好了，太好了！就是那把钥匙，给我！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#104.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.src: I can't explain the debt I owe you, human... You have no idea how grateful I am..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.dst: 我欠你的人情说都说不清，人类……你不知道我有多感激……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#105.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.src: Say, what's your name, human? {u}? Alright, my name's Kaetan. Go on ahead and get out of here, I'll catch up. If you do get out of this chop-shop, meet me in {p}, I want to give you something there.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.dst: 喂，你叫什么名字，人类？{u}？好，我叫 Kaetan。你先走，离开这里，我随后跟上。如果你真的逃出了这间屠宰场，到 {p} 来找我，我想在那里给你一样东西。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#106.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#107.dst: 救、救、救……救命……求、求……求你了！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#107.speaker: Prisoner

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.src: Huh...? Oh- HEY! The table caught on fire, someone get over 'ere and help me put it out!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.dst: 嗯……？噢——嘿！桌子着火了，快来个人帮我把火扑灭！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#108.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.src: Find and destroy your criminal records
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#109.dst: 找到并销毁你的犯罪记录

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.src: Who are you? Can I help you, human?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.dst: 你是谁？有什么我能帮你的吗，人类？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#111.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.src: WHAT?? Taron, he-he's alive?? And you... made sure he didn't starve in that prison...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.dst: 什么？？Taron，他、他还活着？？而你……让他没在那座监狱里饿死……？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#112.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.src: I... human, I can't thank you enough. Even if he doesn't get out of there, just knowing he's alive is... please, I know it's not a lot, but take this.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.dst: 我……人类，我真不知道该怎么谢你。就算他出不来，光是知道他还活着就……拜托，我知道这不多，但请收下这个。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#113.speaker: Lexdale Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.src: Good evening. Can I help you with anything?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.dst: 晚上好。有什么需要帮忙的吗？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#114.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.src: M-my son? He's alive?!? Oh, sweet baby bovine, that's...! Where is he??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.dst: 我、我的儿子？他还活着？！？噢，我亲爱的小神牛啊，这真是……！他在哪里？？
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#115.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.src: ...the prison, huh? Well... It's good to know that he'll be able to hold on a little longer... Thank you so much, human. Here, take this!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.dst: ……监狱，是吗？嗯……知道他还能多撑一阵子也好……太谢谢你了，人类。来，收下这个！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#116.speaker: Gelibord Citizen

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#117.src: The only way to escape is by heading through the exit door. You'll need to access the control room in order to open it...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#117.dst: 唯一的逃生方法是穿过出口的门。要打开它，你得先进入控制室……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.src: The Prison appears to be lying about almost everything they do to the government, and they appear to buy into it, despite all the rumors about this place.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#118.dst: 监狱似乎在几乎所有事情上都对政府撒了谎，而政府似乎也信了，尽管关于这个地方的传闻满天飞。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#119.src: It looks like the only way to get out of here is through the exit door..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#119.dst: 看来离开这里的唯一办法，就是走那扇出口门……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#120.src: Hey, hey, humie! Yeah, I'm talkin to ya here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#120.dst: 嘿，嘿，人类小家伙！对，我就是在跟你说话……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#120.speaker:
Merchant
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#121.src: So, welcome to the {p}. You're in here for the rest of your life, short-nose, so no use complaining about it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#121.dst: 所以，欢迎来到 {p} 联邦监狱。你要在这里待一辈子了，塌鼻子，抱怨也没用。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#121.speaker:
Prison Guard
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#124.src: There's a dusty key inside, labeled "SUPPLY CLOSETS"
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#124.dst: 里面有一把积了灰的钥匙，标着「补给间」

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#126.src: Some water came out of the shower head.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#126.speaker:
Grook 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿞 󐀂
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#128.src: Looks like there's an inmate being interrogated...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#128.dst: 看起来有个囚犯正在被审讯……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#130.src: It's blocked off, though the holes in the fence are wide enough for you to get something through...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#130.dst: 这里被封住了，不过围栏上的洞大得足以让你把东西塞过去……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#131.src: This must be the exit door..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#132.src: It appears to be completely locked.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#133.src: There's some stuff on the table. It looks like... flesh??
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#133.dst: 桌上有些东西。看起来像……肉块？？

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#134.src: You bite back the urge to vomit... was this once a person???
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#134.dst: 你强压下想吐的冲动……这以前是个人吗？？？

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#135.src: The book is titled 'A GUIDE TO SOUL EXTRACTION'.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#135.dst: 这本书的书名是「抽魂指南」。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#136.src: It'd probably be best not to touch it..

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#137.src: There's some broken bits and pieces of a torture device here..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#137.dst: 这里有一些刑具的碎片……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#138.src: The blade is rusted and completely stained with dried blood..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#138.dst: 刀锋已经生锈，整片沾满了干掉的血……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#140.src: There's some cheese inside of the crate.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#141.src: This must be the warden's office...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#141.dst: 这一定就是典狱长的办公室……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#142.src: The warden seems very engrossed in her writing..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#142.dst: 典狱长看起来很专注在写东西……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#143.src: You place the cheese on the floor, where the rat had run by...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#143.dst: 你把奶酪放在地上，就放在老鼠跑过的地方……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#144.src: Looks like the rat dropped something when it ran away...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#144.dst: 那只老鼠逃走的时候好像掉了东西……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#145.src: You managed to fill your bucket with some water.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#145.dst: 你成功在桶里装了一些水。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#146.src: You throw the water bucket onto the generator...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#146.dst: 你把整桶水泼到发电机上……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#147.src: Looks like something popped out of the generator...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#147.dst: 好像有东西从发电机里弹出来了……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#148.src: Looks like you've cleaned up all the messes! You should return to the Guard at the entrance of the hallways to tell him that you're done.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#148.dst: 看来你把所有脏乱都清干净了！你该回到走道入口的守卫那里，告诉他你做完了。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#149.src: You're escorted back to the cell block by the guard...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#150.src: The two of you arrive just as rollcall is about to begin. Some guards shove you into place with the other prisoners...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#150.dst: 你们两个刚到，点名就要开始了。几个守卫把你推去和其他囚犯站在一起……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#151.src: You're escorted to the cafeteria by the guards...

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#152.src: You're escorted out of the cafeteria and back to your cell...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#152.dst: 你被押出食堂，带回牢房……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#152.speaker:
Grook 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿞 󐀂
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#153.src: Looks like that's the end of today... Your top priority tomorrow should be to devise a plan to escape the prison. Finding a guard outfit could be helpful, as well..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#153.dst: 今天看来就到这里了……明天最要紧的是想出越狱的计划。找到一套守卫制服应该也有帮助……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#153.speaker:
Grook 󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿞 󐀂
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#154.src: [{~}/{~}] ??? Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#154.dst: [{~1}/{~2}] ??? 好了！所有人，起来！离开牢房，现在！点名时间到了！

similar.text: Alright! Everyone, get up! Out of your cells, NOW! It's time for rollcall!

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#155.src: There's a lockpicking kit inside of this crate!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#155.dst: 这个箱子里有一套开锁工具！

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#156.src: There's a few stacks of coins inside of this crate.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#156.dst: 这个箱子里有几叠硬币。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#157.src: There are some vegetables inside of this crate.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#157.dst: 这个箱子里有一些蔬菜。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#158.src: This must be the exit door.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#159.src: This should be the most direct way out of the prison... You'll need to get into the control room to open it, though.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#159.dst: 这应该是离开监狱最直接的路……不过你得先进到控制室才能打开它。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#160.src: It's the map of the prison's hallways.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#162.src: Looks like the Warden isn't here during your regular work time... That could be useful later on...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#162.dst: 看来典狱长在你平常干活的时段不在这里……这一点之后可能有用……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#163.src: This must be the control room those inmates were talking about yesterday...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#163.dst: 这一定就是那些囚犯昨天讲的控制室……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#164.src: This room has to be your ticket out of this place. You just need to find a way inside of it...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#164.dst: 这个房间一定是你离开这里的门票。你只要想办法进去……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#165.src: You vaguely remember the rat that had ran by here yesterday...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#165.dst: 你隐约记得昨天有只老鼠从这里跑过……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#166.src: You put the guard uniform underneath your regular outfit. This should help you avoid some suspicion when you make your escape...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#166.dst: 你把守卫制服穿在平常的衣服底下。逃走的时候这应该能少招一点怀疑……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#167.src: Looks like this is all you'll be able to find for now. You should head back to the Guard at the entrance of the hallways to tell him that you're finished working.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#167.dst: 目前看来能找到的就这些了。你该回到走道入口的守卫那里，告诉他你活干完了。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#169.src: Time to take stock of the situation. You need to get out of here, and you might just have found enough out to do it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#169.dst: 该把情况理一理了。你得离开这里，而你打听到的说不定已经够了。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#170.src: The Warden mentioned during rollcall that there's spare control room keys in her office. You'll have to find a way into her office during work time in order to access the control room.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#170.dst: 典狱长点名时提到她办公室里有控制室的备用钥匙。你得在干活的时段想办法进她的办公室，才能进控制室。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#171.src: Alright, now, the rest of you, get to work! Rollcall is over fo-
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#171.dst: 好，现在，你们其他人，干活去！你们的点名结束了！
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#171.speaker: Prison Guard

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#172.src: -The hell? Ow, hey! Get off me, you worthless pests!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#172.dst: ——搞什么？哎，喂！放开我，你们这些没用的害虫！

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#173.src: ...All of you... Get out... Of my sight... NOW.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#173.dst: ……你们全部……从我眼前……消失……现在。
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#173.speaker:
The Warden
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#174.src: Now that the guard isn't standing here, you can more closely inspect this vent...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#174.dst: 守卫不站在这里了，你可以更仔细地检查这个通风口……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#175.src: It looks quite old, and the vent grates appear to be splitting at their seams... it shouldn't take too much effort to just...?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#175.dst: 看起来相当老旧，通风口的栅板接缝处好像裂开了……应该不用太费力就能……？

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#176.src: Perfect! With the grate off, it's relatively easy to squeeze through the vent opening.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#176.dst: 太好了！栅板拆掉之后，要从通风口挤过去就不算难了。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#177.src: These papers on the desk appear to be directed to the Warden.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#177.dst: 桌上这些文件看起来是写给典狱长的。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#178.src: The papers appear to be asking the Warden for...? A quota of souls...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#178.dst: 这些文件看起来是在向典狱长要……？一份灵魂的配额……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#179.src: The signature at the end simply reads the letter D.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#179.dst: 末尾的署名只有一个字母 D。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#180.src: There are some books stacked up in piles right here.

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#181.src: The subject of the books range from the history of the Decay, to spirit magic and... Soul extraction.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#181.dst: 这些书的题材从黯蚀的历史，到灵魂魔法，还有……抽魂。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#182.src: It'd probably be best to stop looking through these.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#182.dst: 最好还是别再翻这些了。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#183.src: The key fits perfectly into the door's keyhole...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#183.dst: 钥匙完全吻合门上的锁孔……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#184.src: There are some papers here about the prison's history..
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#184.dst: 这里有一些关于监狱历史的文件……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#185.src: The papers say that the prison was constructed in {~} AP, and was reserved for Gavel's worst criminals...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#185.dst: 文件上说这座监狱建于 {~} AP，专门关 Gavel 最恶劣的罪犯……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#186.src: It's also the largest prison in all of Gavel, and receives an enormous amount of funding in order to maintain captivity of their inmates...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#186.dst: 它也是整个 Gavel 最大的监狱，为了关住囚犯而领着庞大的经费……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#188.src: It's just instructions on how to operate electromagic appliances.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#188.dst: 只是一些电磁法器具的操作说明。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#189.src: There are a few rusted axe heads in here. The sharp edges are stained with dried blood...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#189.dst: 这里有几个生锈的斧头。锋口上沾着干掉的血……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#190.src: The screen appears to show a map of the entire prison! It looks like after you head through the exit door, you'll have to sneak through a large portion of the prison to escape.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#190.dst: 屏幕上好像显示着整座监狱的地图！看起来你穿过出口的门之后，还得偷偷穿过监狱的一大片区域才能逃出去。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#191.src: Near the back of the prison, there's a room that holds almost all of the records in the prison... You might be able to destroy your criminal record if you reach it!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#191.dst: 监狱后方有一个房间，里面放着监狱里几乎所有的记录……要是能进去，也许就能把你的犯罪记录毁掉！

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#192.src: There's a lever on this control panel that is labeled with the words "UNLOCK EXIT DOOR".
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#192.dst: 这个控制面板上有一根拉杆，标着「解锁出口的门」。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#193.src: You can hear the sound of a door opening in the distance... the exit door must have just opened!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#193.dst: 你听到远处有门打开的声音……出口的门一定刚刚开了！

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#194.src: This screen appears to show some information about guard patrols and placements in the second half of the prison...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#194.dst: 这个屏幕上好像显示着监狱后半部守卫巡逻与配置的信息……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#195.src: ...The entire area is going to be crawling with guards. You're going to have to sneak through them all in order to escape the prison for good.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#195.dst: ……整个区域都会有守卫在巡。你得从他们之间全部偷偷穿过去，才能真正逃出这座监狱。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#196.src: There's some extremely dark looking metal inside of this closet. You can't tell what it's used for...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#196.dst: 这个柜子里有一些看起来极黑的金属。你看不出它是做什么用的……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#197.src: This cabinet has a number of letters between Gavel's government and the Prison.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#197.dst: 这个柜子里有不少 Gavel 政府与这座监狱之间的往来信件。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#198.src: The government must not care about the lives of anyone who lives in Gavel's northern forests enough to condemn the prison for all of this slaughter.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#198.dst: 政府大概不够在乎住在 Gavel 北方森林里的人的命，才没有为了这些屠杀去查办这座监狱。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#199.src: These cabinets have some criminal records on a lot of the prisoners here...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#199.dst: 这些柜子里有这里很多囚犯的犯罪记录……

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#200.src: Most of these files are virtually empty, save for a select few that had committed petty thefts some time ago.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#200.dst: 这些卷宗大部分几乎都是空的，只有少数几份记着前些时候的小偷小摸。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#201.src: This box has a few criminal records in here. The first one has your name on it... At least you didn't need to search very long to find it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#201.dst: 这个箱子里有几份犯罪记录。第一份上面就是你的名字……至少你没有找很久。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#202.src: There should be something nearby you can use to destroy it.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#202.dst: 附近应该有什么东西可以用来把它毁掉。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#203.src: You toss your criminal records into the fire. Good riddance.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#203.dst: 你把自己的犯罪记录丢进火里。总算摆脱了。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#204.src: Your record has been destroyed, for now. You can finally leave the prison for good.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#204.dst: 你的记录暂时被毁掉了。你终于可以永远离开这座监狱。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#205.src: This cabinet has a few records on the Warden...but they all seem incomplete.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#205.dst: 这个柜子里有几份关于典狱长的记录……但看起来全都不完整。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#206.src: Hardly any of the information is actually filled out, No age, career history, family, or any other information. She appears to be a complete un-person.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#206.dst: 几乎没有一栏是填好的。没有年龄、没有经历、没有家人，什么资料都没有。她看起来完全不像一个存在过的人。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#207.src: It's as if she just popped into existence for the sole purpose of being this prison's warden.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#207.dst: 好像她存在的唯一目的就是当这座监狱的典狱长。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#208.src: Have you seen the ruins of the mansion out to the southwest of town? It's really something, huh?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#208.dst: 你看过镇子西南边那座宅邸的废墟吗？很有看头吧？

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#209.src: Folks around here say it's cursed, and I'm one to agree. That place... it just feels wrong, you know?
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#209.dst: 这附近的人都说那里被诅咒了，我也这么觉得。那个地方……就是让人觉得不对，你懂吧？

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#210.src: One of the weirdest things about it, though... sometimes, when you go near the graves... there's this odd ticking sound.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#210.dst: 不过那里最怪的一点是……有时候你走近那些坟墓……会有一种奇怪的滴答声。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#211.src: I'd suggest you stay away from there. Wouldn't want to get cursed by proximity...
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#211.dst: 我建议你离那里远一点。可不想因为靠太近被诅咒……
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#211.speaker:
Burtur
󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿿󏿬󐀂

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#212.src: There you are! Good to see you managed to escape that horrid place!
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#212.dst: 你在这里！很高兴看到你逃出了那个可怕的地方！

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#213.src: But seriously, thank you, {u}. I thought I was going to get killed in there! This isn't much, but hopefully it can help you get back on your feet after all of that.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#213.dst: 不过说真的，谢谢你，{u}。我以为我要死在里面了！这不算什么，但希望能帮你在那一切之后重新站起来。

Forbidden Prison (Quest)#214.src: Anyways, I have to go now. But if I can ever help you with anything at all, just let me know! I'm forever in your debt, human.
Forbidden Prison (Quest)#214.dst: 总之，我得走了。但只要有任何我帮得上的地方，尽管跟我说！我永远欠你一份，人类。
